column1: # Seconds each integration test class took in CI run 43271700507 (2026-11-12), including its
# context start and containers. IntegrationTestShardsTest checks that splitting the classes by
# name hash balances these times. The split itself reads no record, so a stale one costs nothing.
# The first class of a test JVM also pays for PostgreSQL, Flyway and the first context, which
# every shard pays once, so PostgresLockTestSupportIT is listed with its test methods' time.
